description: List the Bronx buildings (10+ apartments) with the most open hazardous violations per apartment, with eviction counts. Use the building column (street address) for chart labels.

configuration.query:
FROM hpd_violations, evictions METADATA _index
| EVAL is_v = CASE(_index == "hpd_violations", 1, 0), is_e = CASE(_index == "evictions", 1, 0)
| STATS open_hazardous_violations = SUM(is_v), evictions = SUM(is_e), apartments = MAX(units), building = MAX(address.keyword) BY bbl
| WHERE apartments >= 10
| EVAL violations_per_apartment = ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(open_hazardous_violations) / apartments, 2)
| SORT violations_per_apartment DESC
| KEEP building, violations_per_apartment, open_hazardous_violations, apartments, evictions, bbl
| LIMIT 10
